purpose: Teach: チューナー/チェックポイント/オペレーター/コントローラー/ビデオテープ/サイコロ/バーナー/ホーン

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内テレビのチューナーを地デジ対応にしましょう
lines.en: Let's upgrade the office TV tuner to digital broadcast standards.
lines.style: Clear, task-oriented. Slight forward momentum on the proposal. Confident but collaborative—inviting agreement, not demanding. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。物流チェックポイントを五カ所増設します
lines.en: Got it. I'll expand the logistics checkpoints to five new locations.
lines.style: Steady, attentive confirmation. Light acknowledgment on the opening word. Measured pace that shows he's taking mental notes. Warm professionalism.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 受付オペレーターの応対品質を上げましょう
lines.en: And let's improve the quality of our reception staff's interactions with customers.
lines.style: Brisk but thoughtful. Slight pause before the proposal—gathering her reasoning. Even tone, expectation of engagement. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製造ラインのコントローラー保守契約を更新します
lines.en: Yes. I'll renew the maintenance contracts for the production line controllers.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Deliberate, thorough. Shows he understands the scope. Steady tempo. Reliable and present.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 旧映像のビデオテープから動画化を急ぎましょう
lines.en: We should prioritize converting those old videotapes into digital format.
lines.style: Directive with urgency underneath. Forward lean in the phrasing. Emphasis lands on the time-sensitive nature. Still collaborative—'we', not 'you'.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員研修にサイコロを使ったロールプレイを採り入れます
lines.en: Understood. I'll introduce dice-based role-play scenarios into the staff training program.
lines.style: Clear commitment in the opening. Slight lift on the concrete details—showing he sees the creative angle. Engaged tempo. Ready to move forward.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 工場の業務用バーナーの定期点検を入れましょう
lines.en: Let's schedule regular inspections for the factory's commercial burners.
lines.style: Calm, safety-conscious. Weight on the word 'regular'—this is important. Measured delivery. Professional but not cold. Directive-collaborative.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。緊急時のホーン信号の練習をします
lines.en: Yes. We'll run drills for the emergency horn signals.
lines.style: Final confirmation, settling and grounded. Slight fullness on 'We'll'—shared responsibility. Calm closing pace. Acknowledgment and completion.
